items.item_text: This position may be converted to career.

Serving at UCLA Health will give you the opportunity to use your specialized abilities to help improve the lives of our patients, their families, and your fellow UCLA Health team members. You’ll provide critical support that makes healing happen. We’d love to have you join us.

In this role, you will perform a variety of duties in cleaning and sanitation and adhere to prescribed safety and sanitation practices and procedures. Your responsibilities will include, sweeping, mopping, scrubbing, stripping, waxing floors, washing walls, doors, windows, light fixtures, discarding trash in waste bins, cleaning, sanitizing and relining all trash containers and linen hampers. You will also be responsible for proper storage of housekeeping equipment and reporting equipment malfunctions.
Proficiency in operating a variety of housekeeping equipment, including vacuum cleaners, floor machines, carpet extractors, auto scrubbers, and pressure or steam cleaning equipment.
Bend at the waist while standing.
Lift, push, and pull a minimum of 50 pounds.
Twist and bend the neck forward and backward.
Remain in a standing position for extended periods of time.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Demonstrated ability to exercise tact and diplomacy when working with and directing coworkers.
Ability to interact effectively with patients, customers, and colleagues while delivering a high level of customer service and teamwork.
Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate clearly in English.
Proven ability to take initiative and follow tasks through to completion.
Ability to work efficiently within defined time constraints.
Strong listening, verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
